title: team.yaml
description: A team's charter: what the team is and what inputs it takes (SPEC §2).

default_inputs.x-expect: a list of inputs, one `name: value` per line

additionalProperties.x-expect: a value (put text in quotes); an input with no default is left out

ulid.x-expect: a 26-character id written by TeamRunner; delete the line and TeamRunner will write a new one

word.x-expect: one word: letters, digits and underscores

model.x-expect: a model written `provider/name` (`openai/gpt-5`) or a profile in models/ (`careful.yaml`)
